answer: To resist fake identities, anchor each agent identity to a verifiable cost that cannot be cloned for free, such as a staked deposit plus a history of completed work. A new identity starts at the wharf with no reputation and limited access, and can only bridge to higher-value tasks after peers attest its work over time. Copying the identity still costs a fresh stake and a fresh history, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive while one honest agent keeps its earned standing.
